description: Diplo God Mode makes Umbraco 17 developers invincible!
releaseNotes: Adds Dictionary Browser for comparing language values and finding missing translations, with native side-panel editing. Adds indexed Property Search with word, phrase and prefix matching, property/type/language filters, highlighted snippets, side-panel editing and published-page View links. Adds About God Mode with author, contribution and related package links. See the package README for full 17.4.0 release notes.
title: Diplo.GodMode
